description.text:
iSmash specialises in offering a trusted express repair service for smartphones, tablets and computers complimented with a wide range  of mobile accessories and refurbished handsets. We also offer liquid damage repair, logic board repair and data recovery.

We pride ourselves on while you wait turnaround times, a 12 month warranty and guaranteeing the security of your private data. Having grown to 12 locations across London, iSmash is quickly becoming the go to brand for tech users for professional express repairs. We specialise in repairing iPhone; iPad; iPod; Mac; Samsung; HTC; Sony; Huawei; LG; Google; Nokia, Dell and many other manufacturers. Book an appointment at ismash.com to receive the best possible service.

Location: Canada Place
